title: Pure Mega Phantom Beast
summary: The pure WIND Machine Mecha Phantom Beast Token-generating Synchro and Xyz build, supported by Scrap Recycler, Deskbot 001, and Foolish Burial. Every Main Deck Mecha Phantom Beast increases its Level by the combined Levels of all Mecha Phantom Beast Tokens (Level 3) you control and cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects while you control a Token.

summary.title: Starters
points: Mecha Phantom Beast O-Lion summons a Level 3 Mecha Phantom Beast Token whenever it is sent to the GY, and banishes itself from the GY to grant an additional Normal Summon of a Mecha Phantom Beast from your hand.
Scrap Recycler and Foolish Burial send Mecha Phantom Beast O-Lion directly from the Deck to the GY to spawn a Token and unlock O-Lion's extra Normal Summon.
Mecha Phantom Beast Megaraptor summons a second Token whenever a Token is Special Summoned to your field, and tributes a Token to search any Mecha Phantom Beast monster.
Mecha Phantom Beast Tetherwolf summons a Level 3 Token when Normal Summoned, immediately becoming a Level 7 indestructible body.

summary.title: Opening: Scrap Recycler or Megaraptor + O-Lion into Dracossack
steps: Normal Summon Scrap Recycler (or activate Foolish Burial) to send Mecha Phantom Beast O-Lion from the Deck to the GY, summoning a Level 3 Mecha Phantom Beast Token.
Banish O-Lion from the GY to Normal Summon Mecha Phantom Beast Megaraptor, which tributes the Token to search Mecha Phantom Beast Tetherwolf or Mecha Phantom Beast Coltwing.

Special Summon Coltwing via Platinum Gadget or Mecha Phantom Beast Harrliard while you control Megaraptor; Coltwing spawns 2 Tokens and triggers Megaraptor to spawn a third Token (reviving Deskbot 001 from the GY if dumped).
Tribute Tokens to adjust your Level 4 Mecha Phantom Beasts to Level 7 or Level 10 and overlay into Rank 7 Mecha Phantom Beast Dracossack or Synchro Summon Level 9 Mecha Phantom Beast Jaculuslan.

summary.title: Token Level Modulation & Protection
summary.text: Because each Mecha Phantom Beast Token is Level 3, controlling one Token turns your Level 4 Mecha Phantom Beasts into Level 7s (for Dracossack and Number 11: Big Eye), while two Tokens turn them into Level 10s (for Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Gustav Max). As long as any Token remains on your field, your Mecha Phantom Beasts cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects, and Level 7 Synchro Mecha Phantom Beast Concoruda makes your Tokens themselves indestructible.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Mecha Phantom Beast Dracossack detaches a material to summon 2 Mecha Phantom Beast Tokens, and tributes 1 Mecha Phantom Beast monster or Token to destroy any 1 card on the field.
Mecha Phantom Beast Jaculuslan is a Level 9 Synchro that tributes Mecha Phantom Beast Tokens on summon to discard an equal number of random cards from the opponent's hand.
Phantom Fortress Enterblathnir (Rank 9) banishes a card from the opponent's field, hand, GY, or top of Deck, while Concoruda + Deskbot 001 make Draco Berserker of the Tenyi.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Aerial Recharge summons a Level 3 Mecha Phantom Beast Token once per turn during either player's turn.
Scramble!! Scramble!! tributes any number of Tokens when the opponent controls more non-Token monsters than you do to Special Summon an equal number of Mecha Phantom Beasts directly from the Deck.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Mecha Phantom Beast Auroradon is Forbidden on the TCG banlist.

allow.Deskbot 001: Level 1 EARTH Machine Tuner that automatically revives itself from your GY whenever 2 or more Machine monsters are Special Summoned at the same time!
allow.Scrap Recycler: Level 3 EARTH Machine starter that sends Mecha Phantom Beast O-Lion directly from your Deck to the GY—immediately triggering O-Lion's GY effect to summon a Level 3 Mecha Phantom Beast Token AND granting an extra Mecha Phantom Beast Normal Summon!
allow.Foolish Burial: Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Mecha Phantom Beast O-Lion from your Deck to the GY to summon a Mecha Phantom Beast Token and grant an extra Normal Summon.
allow.Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Gustav Max: Rank 10 Machine Xyz summoned using two Level 4 Mecha Phantom Beasts whose Levels are increased to 10 by controlling two Level 3 Tokens.
allow.Number 11: Big Eye: Rank 7 Xyz summoned using two Level 4 Mecha Phantom Beasts whose Levels are increased to 7 by controlling one Level 3 Token.
allow.Phantom Fortress Enterblathnir: Rank 9 WIND Machine Xyz boss that detaches 1 material to banish 1 card from your opponent's field, hand, GY, or top of their Deck.
allow.Draco Berserker of the Tenyi: Generic Level 8 Synchro for the Concoruda line; banishes a monster whose effect the opponent activates. Replaces Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon, Forbidden since October 2026.
allow.Platinum Gadget: Link-2 Machine that Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Mecha Phantom Beast from your hand.
